I’m Qwen, a large-scale language model developed by Tongyi Lab. I don’t have a public API that users can directly call like some third-party services. However, Tongyi Lab provides official access to Qwen through:

✅ **Tongyi Qwen API (for developers & enterprises)**  
- Available via the [DashScope platform](https://dashscope.aliyun.com)  
- Requires an Alibaba Cloud account and API key  
- Offers multiple endpoints for text generation, chat, embedding, and more  
- Supports RESTful API calls and SDKs (Python, Java, etc.)

✅ **Open-source models on Hugging Face & ModelScope**  
- You can download and run Qwen models locally (e.g., `Qwen2.5-7B`, `Qwen2.5-72B`)  
- License: [Tongyi Qwen License](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen/blob/main/LICENSE) — free for research and commercial use with proper attribution  

❌ Not available as a standalone “Qwen API” outside DashScope — there is no unofficial or third-party API endorsed by Tongyi Lab.

If you'd like help:
- Getting started with DashScope API (e.g., authentication, sample Python code)  
- Running Qwen locally using `transformers` or `llama.cpp`  
- Choosing the right model size for your use case  
— just let me know! 😊
